README.md.content:
# From Isolated to Org-Wide

> Individual Cursor usage is not the same as company fluency.

## What you will learn

- Diagnose adoption stage from signals
- Draft a 30/60/90 that fits team maturity
- Choose guardrails that protect without killing velocity
- Replace completion vanity with fluency metrics
- Run a workshop for the first 50 engineers

Wrong answers reduce your score. Pass at **70%**.

Rollout/stages-model.md.content:
# Adoption stages

1. **Pilot** — curious ICs, no shared rules
2. **Champions** — team norms, office hours
3. **Guardrails** — privacy, approved MCP, review norms
4. **Fluency ops** — metrics beyond completion, launch-coupled education

Signals of Pilot: power users exist, managers still ask only for completion %.

Rollout/playbook-30-60-90.md.content:
# 30/60/90 draft (edit)

Day 0-30: _____ (pilot scope)
Day 31-60: _____ (champions)
Day 61-90: _____ (guardrails + metrics)

Guardrails/privacy.md.content:
# Privacy & velocity

Good guardrails: secrets policy, repo allowlists, approved MCP, rules packs.

Bad guardrail: ban all AI tools company-wide — it kills learning and drives shadow usage.

Guardrails/rules-packs.md.content:
# Rules packs

Ship org rules the way you ship lint configs — versioned and reviewed.

Metrics/fluency-glossary.md.content:
# Fluency metrics (not vanity)

- Activation: first guided mission with Chat+Terminal
- Agent depth: multi-file change with tests
- Editorial judgment: rejected unsafe accepts
- Anti-metric: video completion % alone

Workshop/facilitator-guide.md.content:
# Facilitator guide

Do not demo Chat-only.
Force a diff-review exercise.
End with named owners for fluency metrics.

missions.title: Diagnose stage
missions.hint: Run adoption diagnose, then pick the stage.
missions.teach: Stage diagnosis drives the rest of your rollout. Mislabeling Pilot as Fluency ops wastes budget.
missions.brief: Signals: 12 power users, no shared rules, managers ask for training completion %. What stage?

choices.label: Fluency ops
choices.feedback: Too early — no shared rules or guardrails yet. Re-read stages-model.md.

choices.label: Pilot (isolated usage)
choices.feedback: Correct. Power users without shared infrastructure = Pilot.

choices.label: Guardrails complete
choices.feedback: Guardrails are not in place. This is still Pilot.

missions.fallbackReply: Run `adoption diagnose`, then choose the stage.

missions.title: 30/60/90 draft
missions.hint: Include pilot, champion, and guardrail language.
missions.teach: A usable 30/60/90 names the stage intent for each window.
missions.brief: Edit the playbook so it includes pilot, champion(s), and guardrail(s), then Validate.

playbook.fail: Include the words pilot, champion(s), and guardrail(s).

missions.title: Guardrails
missions.hint: Pick velocity-safe policy, then policy lint.
missions.teach: Guardrails should teach safe defaults, not prohibit learning.

choices.label: Ban all AI tools company-wide
choices.feedback: That is the anti-pattern — prohibition without enablement.

choices.label: Allowlisted MCP + secrets policy + rules packs
choices.feedback: Yes — guardrails that teach. Run `policy lint`.

policy lint.output:
OK privacy
OK rules-packs
WARN: no fluency metric owner yet
policy lint.reply: Policy lint clean enough to move to metrics.

missions.fallbackReply: Choose allowlisted MCP + secrets + rules, then `policy lint`.

missions.title: Fluency metrics
missions.teach: 92% completion with 18% agent depth is a vanity trap.
missions.brief: Dashboard: 92% completion, 18% agent depth. What do you report to the VP?

choices.label: We are done — 92% completion
choices.feedback: Vanity trap. Depth and unsafe accepts matter more.

choices.label: Activation + agent depth + unsafe-accept rate
choices.feedback: Exactly. Run `fluency report` to lock the metric set.

fluency report.output:
activation=0.41
agent_depth=0.18
unsafe_accept=0.11
completion=0.92  ← do not optimize alone

missions.fallbackReply: Pick fluency metrics, or run `fluency report`.

missions.title: Workshop dry-run
missions.hint: Force diff review — not Chat-only demos.
missions.teach: Workshops that only show Chat recreate isolated usage.
missions.brief: Confirm your run-of-show for the first 50 engineers.

choices.label: Confirm: diff review + metrics owners named
choices.feedback: Run-of-show locked. You are ready to enable the org.

choices.label: Just show Chat-style demos
choices.feedback: That recreates isolated usage. Force a lab + diff review.
